items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: He had learned a solo that was played by the tenor saxophone player with Andy Kirk.

ctx.x: if they like to play, they usually seek somewhere to play afterwards, which brought about jam sessions of all kinds. And at my place, where this drummer and I were working, these musicians used to come there after they got off of work. They would come in and they'd play until we got off of work.

I remember once... There was a tenor saxophone player then who later became a lawyer -- his name was Frank Higgs. He had learned a solo that was played by the tenor saxophone player with Andy Kirk. I'm trying to remember his name...
